rule: A test follows its SUBJECT, per ADR 0040 section 2.7. test/playwright/unit/ai/A/B/C.spec.mjs tests ai/A/B/C.mjs, so the source-receive manifest already decides its plane - there is no second authority and no directory guess. Layout mirrors the source planes: edge tests at test/unit/**, cloud tests at cloud/test/unit/** so the Cloud package installs and runs independently. A spec whose exact subject is not a Brain row is resolved by what it IMPORTS, never by its directory: reaching src/, buildScripts/, learn/ or apps/ means it exercises retained Engine surface and stays there. Directory fallback moved 68 specs wrongly and was caught by @neo-gpt-emmy.
